name: gate1-capability-and-environment
description: Gate 1. The job loaded what it was supposed to load, on the hardware it was supposed to run on, with caches somewhere safe.

gates.name: device_arch_is_gfx90a
gates.note: MI250X is CDNA2/gfx90a. Several MoE kernel paths assume CDNA3 and fail here, so the arch must be recorded explicitly rather than inferred.

gates.name: cxi_provider_visible
gates.note: The CXI provider carries RCCL traffic over Slingshot. Optional because the full image does not ship fi_info, so this is skipped rather than failed when the tool is absent -- see fi_info_available below.

gates.name: fi_info_runs
gates.note: KNOWN FAILING on the 2026-05-13 release, all variants. fi_info is on PATH but is a wrapper exec'ing /opt/mpi/libfabric/bin/fi_info, which is not installed, so it exits 127. A user cannot enumerate fabric providers from inside the container -- the first tool you would reach for when debugging a Portals/CXI error such as PTLTE_NOT_FOUND.

gates.name: aws_ofi_nccl_recorded
gates.note: aws-ofi-nccl is the RCCL/libfabric plugin and the only comms-stack package that changed between the April and May 2026 builds. Its version must appear in every run record.

gates.name: tmp_is_node_local
gates.note: Per-node /tmp is the only safe home for JIT caches at 64+ ranks.

gates.name: triton_cache_off_lustre
gates.note: Lustre-backed Triton caches lose atomic-write races at 64+ ranks: a rank reads a partial entry, raises JSONDecodeError, dies, and the rest hang at the next collective.

gates.name: inductor_cache_off_lustre
gates.note: Same failure mode as the Triton cache.

gates.name: scratch_visible
gates.note: Bind mounts actually reached the container.

gates.name: projappl_visible
gates.note: /projappl is a symlink into /pfs/lustrepN. Passing a realpath-resolved path into singularity broke this historically; the current bindings module binds /pfs, so this gate records whether that is still an issue.

gates.name: device_count_matches_binding
gates.note: One GCD per rank. The container sets ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES from its OCI ENTRYPOINT, which `apptainer exec` never runs -- only `apptainer run` does. Under exec without a launcher-side wrapper a rank sees all 8 GCDs, multiplying per-node fabric endpoints. A value of 8 here means binding did not happen.
